about.title: About
about.intro: I work on orienteering and web projects. For my graduation thesis, I am implementing simulations in Python and Julia.
about.experience: In a previous part-time role, I built websites with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. My current internship focuses on AI-assisted no-code development, and I am also learning React and Next.js through personal projects.
about.learning: I want to understand how software works and develop the skills to implement and improve it myself.
about.subtitle: About Orinrin
about.description: A creator who loves orienteering and nature. Sharing the joy of orienteering through map-making and web development.
about.missionText: Making orienteering more accessible. Delivering the joy of running through nature to more people, powered by maps and technology.
about.visionText: Conveying the beauty of the field through maps, and contributing to the growth of the orienteering community.
